messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — Sales flagged a Fortune-class evaluation (FinBank). They want zero-downtime operator upgrades, preservation of public IPs across upgrades, and an air-gapped installer artifact. Need timeline + gating criteria by EOD Friday.
Priya Suresh: Ok, treat as priority-risk. We should scope narrowly: what can we commit for a pilot vs long-term plan?
Samir Patel: Technical tradeoffs: true zero-downtime requires staged control-plane handover, KV-cache migration semantics, and session affinity handling. Preserving public IPs touches operator/installer + cloud IPAM behaviors.
Morgan Lee: Packaging note: we could add an --ip-preserve flag to the installer to avoid recreating LBs and reassigning IPs. Need to validate LB lifecycle on AWS/GCP and a post-install probe.
Jin Park: For air-gap, we already have bundle-gen but missing a signed manifest and offline dependency checks that auditors ask for. We can add signer tooling to generate a signed manifest.
Lina Gómez: Field wants: clear rollback window (<=15m), preflight that verifies firewall/NAT rules, and deterministic cluster-by-cluster upgrade plan (so netops can approve).
Priya Suresh: Proposed scoped initiative: "VPC Upgrade Safety" with three deliverables: (A) IP-preserve installer option + docs, (B) Zero-downtime upgrade pattern (canary + shadow), (C) Air-gapped signed bundle + preflight validator. Suggest priority: A then B then C for initial Q2 work.
Samir Patel: Note: (B) needs operator API changes (drain-preserve) and runtime changes for KV handoff. Will require eng-runtime coordination.
Morgan Lee: For (A) I'll prototype CLI: `redwood-installer apply --ip-preserve --skip-lb-replace` plus ipam/post-check hooks. Need e2e tests for aws-ip-preserve and gcp-ip-preserve.
Alex Chen: Launch criteria proposals: (A) e2e pass on 2 clouds, rollback docs, and 2-3 pilot customers committed. (B) internal canary + one paying beta, SLO impact <5% p50 change. (C) signed manifest, checksum verification, and security review completed.
Jin Park: I'll own (C) manifest/signing work. ETA ~6 weeks if unblocked.
Samir Patel: I'll own operator changes for (B). Estimate ~8 weeks if cert migration is parallelized. Need runtime time.
Morgan Lee: I'll own (A) and e2e. Can deliver a minimal prototype this week to prove skip-lb flow.
Lina Gómez: I'll draft customer handoff checklist: netops sign-off, IP ownership verification, rollback steps, and acceptance tests.
Priya Suresh: Add gating: mandatory cross-team review before pilot; include networking preflight in gating checklist.
Alex Chen: Action: Samir + Morgan + Jin + Lina sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. Priya to review prioritization after sync. I'll inform Sales.
Tess (release-bot): Meeting created: #VPC-upgrade-safety-sync at 10:00 AM PT tomorrow. Agenda: ownership, launch criteria, risk matrix.
eng-prod-bot: CI: packaging-offline-bundle build #482 succeeded (artifact available).
Samir Patel: Ops requirement: document fallback when IP-preserve fails (e.g., ISP/NAT changes). Include clear rollback execution path for field engineers and Sales playbook.
Priya Suresh: +1 — include explicit sign-off checkbox in runbook that IP-preserve was validated pre-upgrade.
Alex Chen: If scope looks large, propose trimming (B) for initial pilot and only do (A)+(C) if necessary. Otherwise proceed with three deliverables and PRD by Wed.
Lina Gómez: I'll upload checklist draft to roadmap folder and tag field.
Jin Park: Sample bundle-gen snippet for reviewers: `./bundle-gen --model-lockfile bundle.lock --signer-key /keys/team.pem --output bundle.tar.gz --manifest bundle.json`
Morgan Lee: Adding e2e jobs: aws-ip-preserve, gcp-ip-preserve, onprem-smoke.
Samir Patel: For drain-preserve tests we need a test fixture simulating active KV-cache sessions; adding to test backlog.
Priya Suresh: PRD target Wed. Pilot timeline 6-9 weeks pending resource approval.
Alex Chen: I'll post the plan + tentative timelines to Sales/Field. :thumbsup:
eng-prod-bot: Reminder: attach risk matrix to PRD before review.
Lina Gómez: Will attach risk matrix and draft link in morning.
